gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Noto Sans Meroitic fills the line with lowercase that stands nearly as tall as its capitals. Press Start 2P earns its keep in big, short headings, where its pinned-apart letters look like cut-outs.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-modi: Noto Sans Modi reads clean and modern, with daylight in every curve. Over a long page the low contrast between capitals and lowercase keeps the text smooth, while Press Start 2P stays the playful, retro voice above.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-mono: Noto Sans Mono reads sturdy and spacious, never letting letters touch. Its tall lowercase and generous curve openings make words look large, a steady counterweight to the quirky, retro swagger of Press Start 2P.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-mro: Noto Sans Mro packs dense, tall words into the middle of the line, with wide entrances into each letter. Press Start 2P brings moderate stroke contrast on top, and a larger size for the heading would suit that plain sans.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-multani: Press Start 2P has letters pinned far apart like cut-outs, with joins that thin gently without turning spindly. Noto Sans Multani does the quieter work, its lofty x-height and wide-gapped e carrying the text with a modern ease.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Retro fun on top, a heavy-looking band of text below. Noto Sans Myanmar gives Press Start 2P's lightly engraved brass feel a plain sans partner with a broad, welcoming c.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-nag-mund: Press Start 2P is playful and retro. It shines at headings with comfortable stroke contrast, while Noto Sans Nag Mundari handles the text, its half-unwrapped c and s shapes and big lowercase rivaling the capitals.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-nandinag: Noto Sans Nandinagari reads approachable, with short ascenders and a big lowercase body. Press Start 2P supplies the retro fun up top, its thins only slightly lighter than thicks, and the sans below keeps everything open.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-newa: Noto Sans Newa opens its lowercase e clearly and gives tall bowls and counters a modern, professional feel. Press Start 2P earns its keep in big, short headings.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Towering x-height, terminals held far from the stroke. Noto Sans Nushu stays modern across a long stretch of text, and its lowercase keeps a spacious, confident feel from line to line.
